_comment: Copy this file to server/data/config.json and fill in real values. server/data/ is gitignored — never commit real credentials. See CLAUDE.md § 'Never commit secrets'.

processor._comment: Lutron Caseta/RA3 processor. port 0 = auto-detect (8081 plain, then 8083 TLS).

devices._comment: Populated by the device-discovery flow; safe to leave empty on first run.
devices.name: Kitchen Lights

myq._comment: Chamberlain MyQ garage door account. Credentials are used server-side only.

homeConnect._comment: Bosch/Siemens Home Connect OAuth2 app credentials (register at https://developer.home-connect.com).

smartHQ._comment: GE SmartHQ / Brillion laundry account. Credentials are used server-side only.

myUplink._comment: Nibe myUplink OAuth2 app credentials (register at https://dev.myuplink.com).

totalconnect._comment: Resideo Total Connect 2.0 alarm. userCode is the 4-digit disarm PIN.
